from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.github/qa/gallery-motion-check.txt')
s = p.read_text()
def replace(old, new):
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == 1, old[:120]
    s = s.replace(old, new)
replace("  await page.locator('.gallery-page img').evaluateAll((imgs) => imgs.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; }));\n  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-page img')].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0));", "  await page.evaluate(async () => {\n    const images = [...document.images];\n    images.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; });\n    await Promise.all(images.map((img) => img.decode()));\n    await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));\n  });")
replace("      report.failures.push({ browser: engineName, name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });", "      const pending = await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-gallery-reveal-state=\"pending\"]')].map((el) => ({ class: el.className, bottom: el.getBoundingClientRect().bottom, top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top }))).catch(() => []);\n      report.failures.push({ browser: engineName, name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack, pending });")
replace("    await check(`visible fallback without ${api}`, async (page) => {\n      await ready(page); assert.equal(await page.locator(revealSelector).count(), 0);\n      assert(await page.locator('.project-card').last().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1'));\n    }, {}, `window.${api} = undefined;`);", "    await check(`visible fallback without ${api}`, async (page) => {\n      // Playwright locators themselves require MutationObserver. Inspect raw\n      // DOM while the API is absent, then restore it for the testing tools.\n      await page.goto(`${base}/gallery`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++) {\n        if (await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.project-card').length === 12)) break;\n        await pause(page, 50);\n      }\n      const result = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n        cards: document.querySelectorAll('.project-card').length,\n        enhanced: document.querySelectorAll('[data-gallery-reveal]').length,\n        visible: [...document.querySelectorAll('.project-card')].every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity === '1'),\n      }));\n      await page.evaluate((name) => { window[name] = window.__originalObserver; }, api);\n      assert.deepEqual(result, { cards: 12, enhanced: 0, visible: true });\n    }, {}, `window.__originalObserver = window.${api}; window.${api} = undefined;`);")
replace("      const changed = await pixels(actual, expected);", "      await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, `${engineName}-comparison-${width}-actual.png`), actual);\n      await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, `${engineName}-comparison-${width}-baseline.png`), expected);\n      const changed = await pixels(actual, expected);")
replace("  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {", "  await check('fast viewport jump leaves no passed project hidden', async (page) => {\n    await ready(page);\n    await page.evaluate(() => scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));\n    await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-gallery-reveal-state=\"pending\"]')].every((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0));\n  }, { viewport: { width: 320, height: 844 } });\n  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {")
p.write_text(s)
